'''Lem Thane''' is a young man from [[Emond's Field]].

== History ==
He is the eldest son of [[Jon Thane]]. 

He is eight months younger than [[Rand]].

== Activities ==
Lem also saw the [[Myrddraal|dark rider]] prior to the attack on Edmond's Field on [[Winternight]].
